Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the distribution of false sex offender notifications.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the distribution of false sexoffender notifications; adding a new section to chapter 9A.84 RCW;creating a new section; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that violent sexpredators present a very real threat to our community. Sex offendercommunity notification bulletins issued by law enforcement are a usefultool to increase public safety by allowing communities to know wheredangerous sex offenders are living. However, the distribution of falsesex offender community notification bulletins can unduly alarm thepublic, especially given the legitimate fear the public feels regardingthe presence of dangerous sex offenders in our communities. (2) It is therefore the intent of the legislature to protect ourcommunities both from violent sex offenders and from persons whofrighten our communities by distributing false sex offender communitynotification bulletins.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9A.84 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of distributing a false sex offendercommunity notification bulletin if, with the intent to alarm, harass,or intimidate any other person, he or she distributes informationdesigned to resemble a sex offender community notification bulletinknowing that it is not a sex offender community notification bulletin. (2) Distributing a false sex offender community notificationbulletin is a class C felony. (3) For purposes of this section, "sex offender communitynotification bulletin" means a bulletin created by law enforcement forthe purpose of notifying the public about a registered sex offenderunder RCW 4.24.550.
